result.title: CHROMA-MILL: Joint Low-Light Enhancement and White Balance under Colored Illumination
result.comment: Accepted at WACV 2027. 16 pages (main paper + supplementary material), 7 figures, 7 tables. Project page: https://color.cvc.uab.cat/chromamill/
result.summary: Capturing an image in a low-light environment produces a weak, noisy sensor signal. Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) aims to restore it. Auto white balance (AWB) is also required for every image, and the same noisy signal degrades its ability to infer the scene illuminant. LLIE is typically performed first, followed by AWB, but this strategy remains largely unexamined because existing low-light datasets span a narrow range of illuminants and lack illuminant ground truth for evaluating AWB. We address this with CHROMA-MILL, a RAW dataset of 50 scenes captured with a DSLR and smartphone under four calibrated illuminants at eleven intensity levels. Because light is additive, we blend these captures in the linear RAW domain to synthesize physically valid illuminant mixtures with exact chromaticity ground truth. Benchmarking on this data, we find joint correction is best, and introduce CTI-Retinexformer, which supervises an illumination map, a chromaticity prediction, and an illumination-invariant scene embedding, outperforming the best cascade by 0.7 dB PSNR$_L$ and 1.1 $ΔE_{00}$.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CHROMA-MILL 数据集（50 个场景、四种标定光源、十一个亮度档的 RAW 采集，可在线性 RAW 域混光生成精确色度真值），并给出联合低光增强与白平衡的 CTI-Retinexformer 方法。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究的是 RAW 图像低光增强与自动白平衡的联合恢复，属于底层图像处理，未涉及视觉推理中的 latent 状态、证据获取或停止决策，也无可具体核查的迁移线索。
